description: A script that checks copyright header formats in source files, ensuring correct years and author attribution, and identifying new files in a Git repository.

methods.name: MetadataInParentDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a directory or any of its parent directories contains a 'METADATA' file.

methods.name: GetCreatedFiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of new files added between two Git references, based on environment variables.

methods.name: CheckCopyrightYear
methods.description: Verifies that source files have the correct copyright year and author header.
